text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Palmer… I need your help. It's my mom, she's just… Ugh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What happened? Go ahead and tell me everything!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Okay, I think that was everyone who had something they wanted to talk to me about. Finally time to get my chow on! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, are you for real?! Lunchtime is over already?! Nooo!
